title: Origination Manager – Balkans
description:
About Capalo AI
At Capalo AI , we are accelerating the green energy transition by maximizing the value of large-scale energy storage systems through artificial intelligence and optimization. Our platform, Capalo Zeus VPP™, operates battery energy storage systems as a virtual power plant, helping asset owners generate higher revenues while supporting a more resilient and sustainable energy grid.
The Role
As our first Origination Manager in the Balkans, you will turn short-term optimization and trading of BESS and hybrid assets in the region into long-term contracted, bankable revenue: tolling, floors, vPPAs and route-to-market agreements in cooperation with third parties.
You will structure and price these deals alongside our offtake partners, then own the relationships on all sides of the deal.
Key Responsibilities

• Originate offtaker pipeline across the Balkans and own the fixed-revenue counterparty relationships.

• Build coverage of the region's asset owners, developers and IPPs alongside the team.

• Structure tripartite deals between the asset owner, the offtaker and Capalo AI , articulating Capalo's value to each side of the table, and own the deal from first conversations through term sheet and negotiation to the contractual close.

• Develop structures the market does not offer yet.

• Contribute to Capalo AI 's long-term market view for the Balkans.

• Represent Capalo AI at industry events across the region and grow its reputation in the local markets.

What We're Looking For
Must-haves

• Experience originating and negotiating route-to-market agreements for renewable power or storage assets, plus structuring at least one of: PPAs, financially settled structures (vPPA, CfD, swap), floors or tolling.

• A commercial, sales-driven mindset paired with the analytical rigor to price, evaluate and compare deal structures.

• Fluent English.

• Willingness to travel within Southeastern Europe and occasionally to the Helsinki office.

Nice-to-haves

• Understanding of how a battery earns across day-ahead, intraday, balancing and ancillary markets.

• Direct experience with project finance for renewable or storage assets.

• An existing counterparty network among Iberian asset owners, developers, IPPs or offtakers.

• Comfortable in a fast-moving startup and with modern software, cloud and AI tools.

• Fluent Bulgarian or Romanian.

Why Capalo?

• Work on technology that is accelerating the transition to renewable energy.

• Join a fast-growing company at the intersection of AI and energy markets.

• Work with a highly collaborative and mission-driven team.

• Take real ownership: as our first Origination Manager based in the Balkans, you own the region's offtaker network, its deal structures and its pipeline

• Grow your career fast as the company scales across Europe.

What to Expect
Location: Bulgaria or Romania
Working mode: Remote. Ability to travel within Southeastern Europe is required.
Recruitment process: First interview → Take-home assignment → Technical interview → Bar raiser
How to Apply
If this role sounds interesting and Capalo AI ’s mission resonates with you, we would love to hear from you. Send us your CV through our recruitment portal, and we’ll be in touch.
We review applications on a rolling basis and warmly welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

description:

Sapio Sciences is on a mission to accelerate scientific drug discovery and high-throughput clinical and diagnostics for our clients and partners. The Sapio team consists of expert and highly collaborative scientists, software developers, and professionals passionate about providing a best-in-class lab informatics platform and industry-specific solutions.
Sapio is one of the few software providers to offer a truly unified and highly configurable lab informatics platform and a broad suite of purpose-built solutions. The Sapio platform makes it easy for scientists, laboratory, and bio/informatics professionals to streamline and manage their end-to-end laboratory operations, from instrument data integration to workflow and experiment setup to sample and materials management, data management, and scientific data analysis and reporting.
Working at Sapio
At Sapio, we’re not just building lab informatics solutions. We’re creating tools made for the scientist and motivated to make the world a better place. We understand that lab informatics is about more than managing data or connecting workflows. It’s about making life easier for the scientist and making scientific progress faster for everyone. Our platform delivers the levels of configurability, usability and insight that scientists have only ever dreamed of.
We’re a team of scientists, developers and innovators who question convention and stay focused on what matters most - advancing drug discovery science. We challenge the status quo and respond to the needs at the heart of science with powerful solutions that are simple to use, effortless to evolve and downright easy to love.
As part of the Sapio team, you’ll work in a collaborative and forward-thinking environment where your ideas are valued, your growth matters and your work makes a difference.
We’re proud to partner with leading labs around the world, from ambitious start-ups to global organisations, who trust Sapio to support discovery, development and diagnostics with industry-first science-aware solutions.

This individual will serve as a trusted partner to the executive team and hiring managers, anticipating workforce needs, elevating the candidate experience, and ensuring Sapio is known as a destination for top talent in life sciences software. Living the Sapio brand and building genuine, lasting relationships with candidates and internal stakeholders will guide all activities.

Remote (with a strong preference for candidates based in the US Eastern Time Zone / East Coast)

• CNAPP & Deep Runtime Security: Experience with container security, Kubernetes (K8s) admission controllers, eBPF, and real-time threat detection across multi-cloud workloads.

• Data Security Posture Management (DSPM): Hands-on experience with cloud data governance, automated sensitive data discovery, and data lineage across complex cloud datastores.

• Vertical Security Architectures: Architectural experience designing cloud security solutions in regulated domains (Financial Services, Healthcare, Public Sector) under frameworks like HIPAA, PCI-DSS, or FedRAMP.

🚀 Rohlík otevírá úplně nový sklad v Opatovicích nad Labem. A hledáme nové kolegy, kteří budou u jeho rozjezdu od prvního dne.

Nejde o nástup do skladu, kde už je všechno roky zajeté. Budeš u toho, když nový provoz rozjíždíme, nastavujeme jeho každodenní fungování a postupně vychytáváme procesy tak, aby všechno šlapalo, jak má.

Hledáme nové kolegy, kteří se nebojí provozu, umí si udržet přehled a dokážou zorganizovat práci i lidi kolem sebe.

Pokud tě baví prostředí, kde se pořád něco děje, a nechceš trávit celý den za stolem, čti dál.

📦 CO BUDEŠ MÍT NA STAROSTI?

Budeš přímo v centru dění skladu. Podle aktuální situace budeš hlídat, kde je potřeba přidat, přesunout lidi nebo změnit priority tak, aby celý provoz běžel plynule.

Konkrétně tě čeká:

- řízení toku skladu a rozložení práce během směny,

- operativní organizace lidí a jejich přesouvání tam, kde jsou právě potřeba,

- dohled nad klíčovými místy provozu a rychlé řešení vzniklých situací,

- spolupráce s kolegy z příjmu, expedice a dalších částí skladu,

- práce s provozními čísly a jejich převádění do konkrétních kroků,

- hledání možností, jak nové procesy zjednodušovat a zlepšovat.

Poznáš přitom celý proces - od příjezdu zboží do skladu až po okamžik, kdy hotovou objednávku přebírá kurýr.

👀 KOHO HLEDÁME?

Nemusíš mít za sebou deset let v logistice. Důležitější pro nás je, jak přemýšlíš a jak funguješ mezi lidmi.

Sedneme si, pokud:

- se dokážeš rychle rozhodnout a nezalekneš se dynamického provozu,

- umíš si udržet klid a přehled, i když se kolem tebe děje několik věcí najednou,

- dokážeš přirozeně zorganizovat lidi a jasně jim vysvětlit, co je potřeba udělat,

- máš férový přístup a zároveň se nebojíš převzít odpovědnost,

- čísla pro tebe nejsou strašák a umíš je spojit s tím, co se skutečně děje v provozu,

- přemýšlíš nad tím, jak věci dělat jednodušeji a lépe.

Zkušenost ze skladu, logistiky, výroby, retailu, gastronomie nebo jiného rychlého provozu je určitě výhodou. Pokud jsi ale šikovný/á a máš zkušenost s koordinací lidí odjinud, rádi se s tebou potkáme také.

⏰ JAK BUDEŠ PRACOVAT?

Čeká tě režim krátký/dlouhý týden a 12hodinové směny.

A počítej s tím, že tohle není kancelářská pozice. Většinu směny budeš tam, kde se něco děje - přímo v provozu mezi lidmi.

🥐 CO ZA TO DOSTANEŠ?

Kromě možnosti být u rozjezdu úplně nového skladu Rohlíku nabízíme:

- Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma včetně 10% cashbacku v kreditech na další nákupy,

- možnost placeného volna pro odpočinek a regeneraci,

- dotované obědy,

- kávu, čerstvé ovoce a další občerstvení na pracovišti zdarma,

- 86 Kč na ošatné za každou odpracovanou směnu,

- odměny za pochvaly od kolegů, které můžeš proměnit například za vouchery do Alzy nebo Notina,

- příspěvek na Multisport kartu,

- firemní akce a společné oslavy úspěchů.

💚 PROČ NASTOUPIT PRÁVĚ TEĎ?

Protože nový sklad se otevírá jen jednou.

Můžeš přijít ve chvíli, kdy se tým teprve tvoří, procesy se nastavují a tvůj názor i tvoje práce mohou ovlivnit, jak bude celý sklad v budoucnu fungovat.

A než se nový provoz naplno rozjede, rádi ti ukážeme i naše už fungující robotické sklady v Praze.

Chceš být u toho od začátku? Ozvi se nám. Nemusíš psát dlouhý motivační dopis - stačí nám dát vědět, kdo jsi, a rádi se s Tebou spojíme.

description:
We are Hiring!

Sales Tax Specialist
The Sales Tax Specialist will report to the CFO and work within the Finance team to manage all aspects of U.S. state and local sales and use tax compliance. The role is responsible for ensuring accurate and timely filing across multiple jurisdictions, managing the company’s nexus footprint, supporting audits and controversy, and maintaining tax automation systems. The Specialist will partner closely with all relevant stakeholders to ensure indirect tax obligations are met and risks are proactively managed.
While this is a remote role, an East Coast location is required for optimal collaboration with our Europe based team.
Key Responsibilities:
Compliance & Reporting

• Prepare, review, and file multi-state sales and use tax returns (monthly, quarterly, and annual cycles) across 30+ jurisdictions.

• Calculate tax liabilities, review GL account reconciliations, and ensure timely remittance to taxing authorities.

• Maintain a compliance calendar and monitor filing deadlines, extensions, and payment due dates.

• Manage exemption certificate collection, validation, and storage - preferably with experience using a certificate management system (e.g. Avalara CertCapture, EXEMPTAX, or similar).

Nexus & Taxability Analysis

• Monitor the company’s economic nexus footprint across all States and applicable territories following South Dakota v. Wayfair.

• Research product and service taxability questions and document conclusions in internal tax memos.

• Evaluate the tax impact of new products, services, business lines, and acquisitions.

Audit & Controversy

• Serve as the primary point of contact for State and local sales tax audits; coordinate document requests and draft responses.

• Identify and quantify potential audit exposures; recommend and implement risk mitigation strategies.

• Manage voluntary disclosure agreements (VDAs) and amended filings where required.

Systems & Technology

• Recommend, administer and maintain tax automation software (Avalara AvaTax, Vertex O Series, or equivalent) including rate updates, product mappings, and nexus settings.

• Partner with IT and ERP teams on system upgrades, integrations, and testing for sales tax logic.

• Develop and maintain standard operating procedures for all compliance processes.

Cross-Functional Support

• Advise internal stakeholders (Sales, Operations, Finance) on sales tax implications of transactions and contracts.

• Support the annual tax provision process by providing accurate indirect tax accrual data.

• Assist with due diligence on mergers and acquisitions from an indirect tax perspective.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or an equivalent qualification.

• CMI (Certified Member of the Institute for Professionals in Taxation) designation preferred, or active pursuit.

Specific Knowledge, Skills and Experience:

• 3-5 years of direct, hands-on U.S. sales and use tax compliance experience.

• Working knowledge of multi-state nexus rules, including economic nexus thresholds post-Wayfair.

• Experience with a major tax automation platform (Avalara, Vertex, Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE, or similar).

• Familiarity with Streamlined Sales Tax (SST) registration and compliance.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data validation).

• Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle NetSuite, or Microsoft Dynamics desirable.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Implementation Engineering)

Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code - testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend - enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery - and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

Position Summary
Forward Deployed Engineers work embedded inside enterprise engineering teams to design and build AI-native automation on the Harness platform. This is a hands-on, code-first role. You will write production code and scripts, build production pipelines, and connect Harness AI Agents into a customer's existing systems, staying engaged until the capability is live in production. You will work directly alongside customer engineers, turning business objectives into working software rather than documentation or advice.
About the role

• Embed inside a customer's engineering organization for the length of a build engagement to design and build agent-driven automation across the software delivery lifecycle.

• Turn what you build into reusable patterns and share them with the broader Harness delivery organization.

• Bring direct feedback to Harness product and engineering teams based on what you learn building in real customer environments.

• Support the transition from custom build to steady-state operation so the customer can independently operate and extend what you built

What Success Looks Like:-A working, production agent integration lives in the customer's environment by the end of the engagement.
-A reusable pattern or template captured in the Solutions Factory as a direct result of the build.
-Customer engineering stakeholders are able to operate and extend the integration without an ongoing Forward Deployed Engineer presence.
-Healthy, ongoing customer adoption of the Harness platform and AI Agents beyond the specific build, achieved by working closely with the customer throughout the engagement rather than handing off at go-live.

About you

• A platform engineering or software engineering background, with hands-on coding, scripting, and integration ability, not configuration-only experience. You are comfortable working directly in a customer's codebase, infrastructure workflows, and CI/CD frameworks.

• Experience building integrations against APIs, event-driven systems, or LLM

The Foundation for Economic Education (FEE) is a leading nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing the economic, ethical, and legal principles of a free society. For 80 years, FEE has been committed to inspiring and educating individuals on the values of personal freedom, entrepreneurship, and sound economic thinking. Through various programs, publications, and events, FEE empowers individuals to understand the economic principles that drive prosperity and fosters a society rooted in individual rights and limited government.

The Student Engagement department leads FEE’s student-facing events. Through a mix of in-person and virtual programs, FEE partners with schools, educators, and organizations to introduce students to the principles of a free society, fostering deeper understanding and thoughtful discussions. From outreach and relationship-building to event logistics and execution, the Student Engagement team works to create engaging, high-impact experiences that challenge and inspire the next generation. Domestically, FEE’s programs have reached students in nearly all 50 states. Internationally, FEE has a growing footprint in Latin America.

The FEE in the Classroom North America Intern will play a key role in supporting the outreach efforts of FEE's Student Engagement team. Working closely with our outreach division, you will gain hands-on experience researching, identifying, and analyzing expansion opportunities, conducting market research, and helping develop strategies to partner with a wider range of institutions. Our team delivers top-tier programs to high school and university students through a dynamic faculty network, and you will support that work end to end. title: Platform Engineering
description:
PLATFORM ENGINEERING AT POLAR

Platform engineering at Polar is about building and evolving the systems that power our product - keeping them fast, resilient and simple as we scale. We’re rethinking how billing works for a world of usage-based software, programmable pricing and AI agents - from real-time metering and pricing as code, to more flexible customer identities, giving developers greater control over how they monetize their products.

Polar sits in the critical path of global payments, billing and financial workflows. Reliability and correctness matter deeply, but so does our ability to move quickly.

We’re looking for engineers who enjoy working across infrastructure, backend systems and the application layer - from improving foundational systems and shipping new platform primitives to building the tooling and automation that enable the entire engineering team to move faster.

We don’t believe in building infrastructure for infrastructure’s sake. We value a pragmatic mindset and sensibility in knowing when to introduce new abstractions and when the simplest solution is the right one.

More about Polar and how we work https://polar.sh/company

WHAT YOU COULD WORK ON

Depending on your experience and where you can have the greatest impact, this could include:

- Keep Polar reliable at scale: Designing and evolving systems that remain highly available, performant and resilient as traffic and complexity grow - identifying bottlenecks, improving critical paths and designing for graceful failure.

- Evolve our infrastructure: Improving our cloud architecture, infrastructure-as-code and environments - introducing complexity only where it earns its place.

- Make production safe and easy to operate: Improving observability, debugging, deployments and incident response so engineers can ship confidently, understand what’s happening in production and recover quickly when things go wrong.

- Build leverage for engineering: Creating primitives, abstractions and automation that remove operational toil and help the broader engineering team move faster.

- Engineer for financial correctness: Translating financial and regulatory requirements into robust technical systems, with auditability, access control and data integrity built in from the outset.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

We’re particularly interested in senior engineers who combine deep systems thinking with exceptional product judgement. People who enjoy solving complex technical problems, take ownership beyond their immediate area and care about building systems that are both robust and easy to work with.

Some of the qualities and experience we value in this area include:

- Strong technical foundations: Backend and systems engineering experience, including distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and operating production systems at scale. This means that you have built and operated such systems over time to see and understand the pitfalls of the initial decisions

- SQL and data modelling depth: Strong experience with relational databases, data modelling, query optimization and designing for data integrity and performance.

- Pragmatic engineering judgement: The ability to reason through complex technical trade-offs, anticipate failure modes and choose solutions that balance immediate needs with long-term maintainability. You’re comfortable moving across infrastructure, backend and application layers to solve the problems that matter.

- Product-minded: An understanding of how engineering decisions affect the product, with the judgement to balance speed, simplicity and robustness.

- End-to-end owner: A willingness to take responsibility for outcomes, from understanding the problem and designing a solution to shipping, operating and improving it.

- Multiplier: An interest in building abstractions, tooling and automation that make the whole engineering team faster and more effective.

- Security-minded: Treating security, access control and auditability as fundamental engineering

title: Founding Recruiter (Robotics and AI)
description:
About Destro AI

Destro AI is building the intelligence layer for robotics - the system that coordinates robots, humans, and workflows across complex real-world operations. Founded by former leaders from HAI Robotics, Dexterity, and Matic, Destro is built on a simple thesis: robotics has solved movement, but not decision-making. Destro is backed by investors who have previously invested in and built companies like Brex, Figma, Notion, and Instacart.

Destro's MothershipOS is a shared brain across all robots, unlocking complex factory and warehouse workflows. Unlike traditional systems that rely on local intelligence on each robot, Destro brings global intelligence across the entire operation. Destro recently closed its Seed round at one of the highest valuations for a robotics company at this stage, and is already deploying in production with large enterprise operators

About The Role

We're hiring a Founding Recruiter to build and run Destro's talent engine. This is one of the first ten hires at the company, and you will own hiring end-to-end as we scale from a small founding team to 20 to 30 new hires a year, most of them engineers. You will be hands-on, sourcing, closing, and building the process as you go, with direct access to the founders and no existing playbook to inherit.

Recruiting here is not a service function. You will have a seat at the table, shape how we hire, and be expected to speak up. Most of your time goes to recruiting and headhunting. The rest goes to supporting the business side: keeping our hiring and people tools running, handling basic HR operations, and helping the sales team with outreach and pipeline tracking.

What You'll Do

Recruiting

• Own full-cycle recruiting for engineering and technical roles, including robotics, software, systems, and field deployment engineers.

• Be a hunter: proactively identify and engage top talent across robotics, ML, systems, and infrastructure, rather than waiting for applicants.

• Build talent heatmaps of the companies, labs, and teams where the best robotics engineers sit, and use them to guide sourcing strategy.

• Source and close passive candidates through LinkedIn, GitHub, research networks, university labs, and referrals.

• Build long-term relationships with candidates who are not ready to move today, so they are warm when the right role opens.

• Partner with founders and hiring managers to define role scope, tradeoffs, and urgency before a search begins.

• Manage offers, negotiations, and closing, working directly with the founders.

Operations and Tools

• Own and administer our hiring technology stack, including the ATS (Breezy), sourcing tools, scheduling, and reporting.

• Build repeatable systems: job description templates, outreach sequences, interview scorecards, and pipeline dashboards. Track and report on KPIs and department metrics.

• Support onboarding logistics and basic HR operations for new hires in coordination with our payroll and HR tools.

Who You Are

• Proven ability to source and close passive candidates on your own.

• Ability to quickly learn our domain and become a deep tech talent expert.

• A desire to become our first talent/HR hire and grow into a future executive at Destro.

• Direct, organized, and seeking a high velocity environments.

Required

• 1+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience (spanning from sourcing to closing).

• Skilled with LinkedIn Recruiter and other AI-native recruiting / sourcing tools.

• Experience hiring technical roles at a startup or high-growth company.

• Strong diplomacy, tact, and experience closing highly sought-after candidates.

Strongly Preferred

• Prior agency experience handling high-volume/cadence or mid-level executive recruiting.

• Experience with AI-native recruiting stack or modern sourcing tools

• Familiarity with basic HR operations, onboarding, and payroll tools.

title: Prompt Engineer (Healthcare)

About us
Talkie builds AI Agents for healthcare . Our agents handle patient-clinic communication end-to-end - voice calls, web chat, and SMS - so patients get 24/7 access to care and busy practices never miss a conversation. Every month, our AI Agents handle close to a million real patient conversations across the US and Poland. Trusted by primary care, specialty practices, and hospitals.
The Role
We're looking for a Prompt Engineer to own the quality and intelligence of our AI Agents - from prompt design to production. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of language, technology, and healthcare. Your work will directly shape how hundreds of thousands of patients experience care.
This is not a research role. You'll be writing, testing, and iterating prompts that run live with real patients - so rigour, empathy, and a zero-error mindset matter as much as technical skill.
What You'll Do

• Design, write, and continuously optimise prompts that power our AI Agents - making them natural, accurate, and reliable.

• Analyse real patient-agent conversations end-to-end, identifying failure patterns, edge cases, and opportunities to improve agent behaviour.

• Propose and implement technical solutions around function calling, tool use, context caching, and other LLM capabilities that make our agents smarter.

• Build and run evaluation frameworks to test agent performance before and after changes - because every conversation is with a real patient and there is zero margin for error.

• Create clear, structured documentation and customisation instructions so that agents can be tailored to each client’s specific workflows and needs.

• Stay on top of the rapidly evolving LLM landscape - new models, techniques, and conventions - and bring the best ideas back to the team.

• Work closely with the Product Manager (US market), engineering, and client teams to ensure agent quality across all deployments.

What will you achieve with us?

• Shape the experience that hundreds of thousands of patients have when they reach out to their doctor - across every channel - and make it better every single day.

• Push the boundaries of what LLM-powered AI agents can do in a highly regulated, real-world, multi-channel environment.

• Build evaluation and quality systems for conversational AI that don’t exist yet - you’ll be creating the playbook.

• Have a direct, measurable impact on patient access to healthcare in both the US.

Requirements
This is a young and fast-moving field. We care less about years of experience and more about how you think, learn, and work.
Must have

• LLM Experience - Hands-on experience writing and iterating on prompts for production systems. More importantly, you learn fast - this field changes weekly and you keep up.

• Analytical Rigour - Ability to review conversations, extract failure patterns, and turn findings into concrete, measurable improvements.

• Communication & Collaboration - Comfort on client calls and working across technical and non-technical teams; you translate clearly in both directions. This is not a “sit in a cave and prompt all day” role ;).

• Proactivity - You spot problems before being asked, flag them, and come with a proposed fix.

• Zero-Error Mindset - Our agents talk to real patients. You understand the responsibility and bring the precision and care it demands.

• English - C1+ English, strong written communication. Our agents talk to US patients.

• Shifted Hours - You are available to work 12:00-20:00 CET at least 3 days per week (optimally 5) to overlap with US Eastern Time business hours.

Nice to have

• Function Calling & Tool Use - Experience with LLM tool-use patterns, structured outputs, and API integrations.

• Evaluation Frameworks - Familiarity with eval tools - Braintrust, DeepEval, LangSmith, or custom pipelines.

• Multi-Channel Experience - Understanding of voice AI nuances: latency, turn-taking, TTS/ASR - and how they differ from chat or SMS.

title: Firm Compliance Partner
description:
About the Business
Quilter plc is a leading wealth management business, helping to enable brighter financial futures for every generation.

Quilter oversees £157.4 billion in customer investments (as of August 2026). It has an adviser and customer offering spanning financial advice, investment platforms, multi-asset investment solutions, and discretionary fund management. The business is comprised of two segments: Affluent and High Net Worth.

Affluent encompasses the financial planning business, Quilter Financial Planning, the Quilter Investment Platform and Quilter Investors, the multi-asset investment solutions business.

High Net Worth includes the discretionary fund management business, Quilter Cheviot, together with Quilter Cheviot Financial Planning - offering a highly personalised service to private clients, charities, trustees, and professional partners. Quilter Cheviot has presence throughout the UK, Ireland and Channel Islands.

At Quilter we never stand still. Our foundations are rooted in our extraordinary expertise, which is trusted by hundreds of thousands of customers, but we have great ambitions to stay one step ahead and make an even greater difference to the people and communities we serve, including our colleagues.

Our business is transforming, continually modernising, and becoming even more customer centric. So, if you want to be bold in the pursuit of your ambitions, bring new ideas, and challenge and evolve what we do, it’s the perfect time to join us! About the Role
Level : Level 4
Department: Supervision & Oversight (QFP)
Location : Home-based
Contract type : Permanent, Full-Time
As a Firm Compliance Partner within Quilter Financial Planning, you will provide regulatory oversight for a varied portfolio of appointed representative firms. Your portfolio will include routine firms and smaller bespoke businesses that are suitable for primarily remote supervision, with occasional travel where the circumstances or risk profile of a firm require it.
You will take end-to-end ownership of your firms, building effective working relationships with Firm Principals and developing a strong understanding of how their businesses operate. You will provide practical support and guidance while retaining the independence and confidence to challenge constructively where regulatory requirements or Network standards are not being met.
You will plan and complete firm attestation reviews and governance assessments, using evidence and professional judgement to assess each firm’s governance, systems and controls. Where concerns or weaknesses are identified, you will agree proportionate action plans, establish clear timescales and monitor progress through to completion.
You will take ownership of identified issues through to an appropriate conclusion, escalating material concerns through the relevant channels when required. You will also support the pre-vetting of firms looking to join Quilter , assessing compliance and conduct risks, providing appropriate challenge and contributing to informed onboarding decisions.
The decisions you make will directly support good customer outcomes by helping firms identify weaknesses early, strengthen their controls and deliver advice and ongoing service to the standards customers should expect.
This is a home-based role where supervision is delivered primarily through Microsoft Teams. You will plan and manage your own workload while contributing to a highly skilled and collaborative team.
Occasional travel will be required where this is appropriate to the needs of the firm or the supervision being undertaken.
About You
You will be a confident communicator, particularly skilled in questioning, and be able to display sound judgment when assessing risks and developing action plans. You will also have strong analytical approach and inquisitive nature.
You will bring a wealth of existing experience working within a compliance role and be competent in providing feedback to advisers/firm principals.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Aptura is looking for Subject Matter Experts from legal practice, restructuring and insolvency, litigation support or legal operations, across disputes, insolvency, commercial or corporate matters, who build claims analyses, damages calculations and spend trackers in Excel. RESPONSIBILITIES

- Writing realistic Excel tasks drawn from your own work: extending existing models, fixing broken ones and building from a brief

- Writing yes-or-no criteria precise enough that a grader can mark any attempt against them

NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years in legal practice, restructuring/insolvency, litigation support or legal operations, covering disputes, insolvency, commercial or corporate matters

- Deep hands-on Excel: claims registers, damages calculations, data cleaning, multi-criteria lookups and error tracing

- Strong written English communication skills.

- Attention to detail, and willingness to learn concepts in AI and Evals

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

- Start Date : Immediate

- Duration: Approximately 4-6 weeks

- Payment: task-based. Experts who complete their first task within the required timeline will then be qualified to do multiple tasks for the remainder of the project.

CONTRACT AND PAYMENT TERMS

- You will be engaged as an independent contractor.

- This is a fully remote role that can be completed on your own schedule.

- Projects can be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on needs and performance.

- Your work at Aptura will not involve access to confidential or proprietary information from any employer, client, or institution.

- Payments will be weekly following task completion.

GETTING STARTED

- Apply with your details and CV. Choose an available 30-minute group walkthrough call.

- Attend the walkthrough and create one original task from your own work. Submit the brief, the actual input workbook(s) needed to complete it. Input-file uploads are compulsory.

- Write the brief yourself. Input workbooks must also be human-built. Use real data that has been sanitised, or public data with the source named. No AI usage allowed.

- We run your task against current frontier AI models. If the models get it wrong, you then write a detailed yes-or-no rubric, and a reviewer signs off on the task with you.

- Completing onboarding does not guarantee a job offer; selection remains subject to written approval of the task proposal.

ABOUT APTURA

Aptura is an applied AI and data company working with frontier labs to train AI systems on real professional work. We do this by building high-quality evaluation and training environments that teach AI agents to produce work that can be used in daily workflows.

The Chief Sustainability Officer (CSO) is responsible for leading the organization's environmental, social, and governance (ESG) strategy and sustainability initiatives. This role ensures the organization meets regulatory requirements, sustainability goals, and long-term ESG commitments while enhancing corporate reputation and business resilience.
Key Responsibilities
ESG & Sustainability Strategy

• Establish sustainability goals, targets, and long-term roadmaps.

• Integrate ESG principles into business operations, investments, and decision-making processes.

Environmental Sustainability Initiatives

Social Impact & Corporate Responsibility

ESG Reporting & Analytics

• Oversee ESG disclosures, sustainability reporting, and impact measurement.

• Develop dashboards and KPIs to measure ESG performance and progress.

Stakeholder & Investor Engagement

• Engage with investors, regulators, clients, and external stakeholders on sustainability matters.

• Represent the organization in sustainability forums and industry discussions.

Sustainable Business Transformation

• Collaborate with business units to embed sustainability into operations, products, and services.

• Support sustainable finance, green initiatives, and responsible investment strategies.

• Identify opportunities for innovation and sustainable growth.

Risk Management & Resilience

• Assess environmental and social risks impacting business operations and investments.

• Develop climate risk and sustainability risk management frameworks.

• Support enterprise resilience and long-term sustainability planning.

Leadership & Culture Development

• Promote a sustainability-focused culture across the organization.

• Lead and mentor ESG, sustainability, and CSR teams.

• Drive employee awareness and engagement in sustainability initiatives.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Business Administration, Finance, or related field; Master's degree preferred.

• 12-15+ years of experience in sustainability, ESG, corporate responsibility, or related leadership roles.

• Strong understanding of ESG frameworks, sustainability reporting, and regulatory requirements.

• Proven track record of implementing enterprise-wide sustainability initiatives.

Key Skills & Competencies

• Strong strategic and sustainability leadership capabilities.

• Expertise in ESG frameworks and sustainability reporting.

• Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills.

• Analytical and risk assessment abilities.

• Change management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Performance Metrics

• Achievement of ESG and sustainability targets.

• Reduction in environmental impact and carbon footprint.

• ESG ratings and reporting complian

title: Finance Manager, FP&A

Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As the FP&A Manager of Core Platform Business Unit Finance, you will drive financial strategy, resource allocation, and operational transformation across our highest-impact product organizations. In this high-visibility role, you will own cost governance across major OpEx and CapEx investments, partnering directly with R&D and senior finance leadership to optimize capital deployment and financial discipline. • We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, California office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

• 5+ years of experience in progressively complex financial planning and analysis (FP&A) roles, with a proven track record of managing end-to-end forecasting in fast-paced environments.

• Advanced expertise in Excel/Google Sheets financial modeling.

• Curiosity and a proactive approach to optimizing operational efficiency by building better workflows.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration and negotiation skills, with a demonstrated ability to build trusted partnerships across technical, operational, and executive teams.

• Working knowledge of core financial accounting operations, including accounts payable (A/P), accounts receivable (A/R), and invoicing functions.

• Self-directed initiative and adaptability to manage multiple complex priorities independently in high-growth, evolving environments.

• Experience partnering with Research & Development teams is a plus.

• Familiarity with SQL, Snowflake, Tableau, or equivalent BI tools for data analysis is a plus.

• Familiarity with leveraging AI to improve processes and dashboarding is a plus.

Software Engineering Job Details

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword - it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce 's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce .
Engineering at Qualified is a high-ownership, high-velocity environment where engineers ship customer-facing product to real enterprises at scale. We’re building at the frontier of AI + product: developing agentic software and embedding AI directly into our platform, using modern toolchains and processes that help engineers move faster while staying focused on high-impact problem solving.

Following our acquisition by Salesforce , we continue to operate with the pace and ownership of a startup-backed by the distribution, resources, and long-term runway of a global enterprise. Engineers have true end-to-end ownership from idea to production: scoping, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement based on real customer feedback, without layers of approvals slowing you down.

The Role

Software Factory is a brand-new team industrializing how we build software. We’re building the platform that lets coding agents do real work against our codebase: remote sandboxes where agents run our full build safely, the orchestration that kicks off that work from Slack, Linear, GitHub, and schedulers, and the observability that makes the output trustworthy at scale.

This team’s product is the factory around them: the sandboxes, triggers, context, review surfaces, and audit trails that turn raw agent capability into dependable engineering output for the whole org.

As a software engineer and one of the team’s first hires, you’ll shape that platform from the ground up while shipping to demanding internal customers from day one: every engineer at Qualified. You’ll partner closely with our CTO on everything the team builds, from architecture and build-vs-buy decisions to what the factory takes on next.

• Partner directly with our CTO to shape priorities, architecture, and what the factory takes on next

• Own delivery from design through launch, monitoring, and iteration

• Help set the patterns for how the entire engineering org works with agents day to day

Who You Are

• Hands-on with coding agents and LLM tooling (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar), with real opinions about where they shine and where they fail

• Proven experience building developer tooling, CI/CD systems, or platform infrastructure that other engineers depend on daily

description:
“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone.  Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor.  Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit  https://mineralystx.com . Follow Mineralys on  LinkedIn ,  Twitter  and  Bluesky ”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Regional Sales Director

The Regional Sales Director (RSD) will play a critical role in the successful launch and growth of Mineralys’ first commercial product within an assigned region. This leader will be accountable for translating national strategy into regional execution, driving business performance through strong field leadership, cross-functional partnership, and disciplined execution against launch objectives.

The RSD will build and lead a high-performing team of territory managers, foster deep customer relationships, and ensure alignment with corporate priorities, compliance standards, and Mineralys’ values. This is a highly visible field leadership role requiring strong business acumen, launch experience, and the ability to lead with urgency in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Leadership / Launch Execution

• Lead all regional launch planning and execution activities to ensure successful market entry and sustained product uptake

• Translate national brand strategy into actionable regional business plans and field execution priorities

• Lead team to achieve or exceed sales goals, market share targets, and key performance metrics at launch and beyond

• Monitor market dynamics, customer feedback, and competitive intelligence to adjust strategy in real time

• Drive accountability for performance through data-driven decision making and disciplined execution

Team Leadership / Coaching

• Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain top-performing territory managers across the region

• Lead, coach, and motivate a team of approximately 8-12 territory managers

• Establish and maintain high level of disease state, clinical and product knowledge

• Evaluate performance of territory managers and coach to skill and career development through regular field contact

• Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

• Build strong succession plans and talent pipelines

Customer / Market Engagement

• Develop and maintain relationships with key healthcare providers, health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs) and strategic accounts

• Partner with territory managers on key customer interactions, access challenges, and develop account strategies

• Support pull-through with IDNs, organized customers, and priority accounts

• timely and effectively sharing of customer insights with internal stakeholders

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with Market Access, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Training, Operations, and HR to support launch readiness and execution

• Provide field-driven input into brand planning, messaging, and tactical adjustments

• Collaborate with Area Sales Directors and peers to share best practices and drive consistency across regions

• Support national meetings, launch planning sessions, and field communications

Compliance / Operational Excellence

• Ensure all regional activities are conducted in full compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and legal standards

• Manage regional budgets and resources effectively

• Maintain accurate forecasting, CRM utilization, and reporting discipline

• Uphold Mineralys’ values of collaboration, integrity, quality, trust, and urgency

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree pref

title: Senior Staff/Principal Software Engineer - GPU System Software, Onboard Execution
description:
Zoox is building the world's most advanced self-driving hardware and software solution. The efficiency demands of such a system require an expert fine tuning of both the compute hardware architecture as well as the algorithms and middleware that runs on it to achieve maximum throughput at the most optimal power levels. 

The Software Performance team keeps the main onboard computer healthy and performant to ensure that our on-bot autonomy software meets its latency targets while also accommodating its safety goals. We are responsible for the efficient allocation of onboard compute resources (CPU/GPU/Memory/accelerators) ensuring contention is minimized and the autonomy stack executes harmoniously.

As the Onboard Execution team leader within the Performance team,  you will lead a highly specialized team of software performance engineers in aggressively optimizing on-bot software runtime. This is a high impact role that sits at the intersection of ML Platform, Core, and Autonomy Software - ensuring that efficient compute utilization is a central tenet emphasized across the organization. 
 
 

About Zoox
Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

title: Founding GTM, T:0
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You’ll be our first GTM hire at T:0, building the sales engine from scratch with no existing playbook to follow. You’ll personally run outbound, triage inbound, take founders from first conversation to paying customer, and identify the channels that consistently create pipeline before we invest heavily in them.

You’ll own the CRM and sales process end to end, defining stages, keeping data clean, and building a pipeline the whole company can trust. You’ll sell to US-based seed-to-Series-A startups through a high-volume, low-friction motion designed to close quickly, while creating a clear path toward self-serve and PLG.

As the business grows, you’ll open new segments yourself, building longer and more considered sales motions alongside the fast one. You’ll generate your own pipeline in partnership with our Head of Marketing and work closely with Airwallex’s Startups team to keep both motions aligned and compounding.

You’ll work from our San Francisco office three days a week.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

- You’ve been the first or only GTM person somewhere before, and you liked it. You have a 0-to-1 mentality and real early-stage startup experience.

- You’ve built a sales motion, not just operated one someone else already proved out.

- You’re comfortable selling to founders and operators at small companies through quick calls, quick decisions, and high-volume activity.

- You’ve sold across different deal shapes, including longer, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

- You’re the person who books the thing instead of just suggesting it. You can get a stranger on a call and leave with a yes, and you’d rather do something scrappy today than something perfect next week.

Preferred

- Experience selling fintech products, especially in accounting, bookkeeping, or the founder finance stack.

- Experience building and managing a CRM.

- Experience using AI to automate sales outbounding.

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

- You’re excited by a category that hasn't been won yet, and want to be early enough to shape it.

- You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

- You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

- You default to action. You'd rather course-correct in motion than wait for perfect clarity.

- You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you’re motivated by stretch goals.

LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

T:0's mission is to make finance run itself. We're building an AI-native accounting platform that closes the books, reconciles, and reports continuously, so founders can stop managing their finances and start using them to run the business. The hard part isn't adding AI to accounting. It's making AI you can trust with the books. Job Description
We are looking for a Product Owner with hands-on experience in AI agents to manage the product backlog, translate business needs into clear requirements, and work closely with engineering teams to deliver reliable AI-powered solutions. The role focuses on configuring and validating agent behavior, defining acceptance criteria, identifying risks and edge cases, and ensuring agents meet quality and safety expectations before release.
Responsibilities

• Own and refine the product backlog for an engineering team developing AI agents.

• Translate business and user needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

• Work closely with engineering to clarify scope, prioritize functionality, resolve ambiguities, and keep implementation moving.

• Participate directly in configuring, testing, and validating agent behavior across relevant interaction channels.

• Define test scenarios, user acceptance criteria, and exit criteria for agent releases.

• Identify edge cases, failure modes, and risks associated with agents interacting with real consumers.

• Ensure appropriate guardrails and expected behaviors are considered before release.

• Support user acceptance testing (UAT), beta preparation, and the collection of feedback with other Hibu stakeholders.

• Use AI tools to improve product workflows while maintaining ownership of the quality and accuracy of requirements.

• Collaborate with the Project Manager, other Product Owners, engineering, QA, and business stakeholders.

Key Requirements

• Direct AI agent experience: Has participated in configuring, testing, integrating, or shipping AI agents as part of a software product or workflow.

• Agent testing and validation: Can define acceptance and exit criteria, design test scenarios, evaluate agent behavior, identify failure cases, and determine readiness for release.

• Product ownership: Has owned or actively managed a product backlog, written requirements and user stories, defined acceptance criteria, and prioritized features with engineering teams.

• Technical understanding of AI: Understands how LLMs, agent workflows, prompts, grounding, guardrails, and AI services work in practice, including their limitations and potential failure modes.

• APIs and system integrations: Understands how APIs and integrations work and can participate meaningfully in technical conversations with engineers. Familiarity with MCP is also expected.

• Agile/Scrum delivery: Understands sprint cadence, development workflows, release processes, and how to keep an engineering team supplied with clear, actionable requirements.

• AI-assisted product work: Has experience using AI tools to support product work and can review, correct, and validate AI-generated requirements rather than relying on unverified output.

title: Senior Integration Developer
description:
Overview
DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Integration Developer to lead the design, implementation, and sustainment of secure data and application integrations supporting a large-scale Department of Defense (DoD) modernization effort. The Integration Developer will engineer RESTful APIs, ETL pipelines, and data validation routines that enable reliable and secure interoperability between enterprise systems, analytics environments, and external mission partners.
The position is responsible for optimizing data workflows, maintaining integration health, and ensuring information exchange remains compliant with DoD cybersecurity and data governance requirements across multiple impact levels (IL2-IL5).
This position is fully remote.
Duties & Responsibilities
The Integration Developer, Senior will:

• Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and data integration services connecting cloud-hosted applications, case management systems, and third-party solutions.

• Implement and manage ETL pipelines for structured and unstructured data sources, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

• Develop data transformation, mapping, and reconciliation logic using scripting languages and integration frameworks.

• Ensure interoperability through API gateway management , secure token handling, and encryption protocols (TLS, AES).

• Perform data validation and quality assurance testing on integration transactions to ensure integrity across environments.

• Collaborate with database administrators to design optimized schemas, stored procedures, and indexing strategies that enhance data access and performance.

• Implement and monitor event-driven integrations using message queues or streaming technologies (e.g., Kafka, SNS/SQS).

• Participate in Agile sprint planning, backlog refinement, and technical reviews to ensure integration tasks align with program priorities.

• Support sustainment and troubleshooting for data synchronization, latency, and connectivity issues across IL2-IL5 cloud tiers.

• Work closely with cybersecurity teams to ensure compliance with DoD RMF, STIG, and Zero Trust security principles.

• Develop and maintain Interface Control Documents (ICDs), API specifications, and integration testing documentation.

• Support post-deployment validation (PDV) and performance monitoring of integration services.
Qualifications
Clearance Requirement:

• Must hold an active Secret clearance.

Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
Experience:

• Minimum 7 years of experience developing and maintaining data integrations or middleware solutions.

• Proven track record in API development, data migration, and system interoperability in secure, cloud-hosted environments.

• Experience supporting large-scale federal or defense programs using Agile or DevSecOps methodologies.

• Technical Knowledge:

• Expertise in Python, Java, or C# for backend development.

• Proficiency with API frameworks (FastAPI, Spring Boot, .NET Core) and data integration tools (AWS Glue, Talend, MuleSoft, or Apache NiFi).

• Experience developing and securing RESTful APIs , web services, and data pipelines.

• Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB).

• Familiarity with AWS GovCloud environments and related services (API Gateway, Lambda, S3, RDS).

• Experience with CI/CD automation (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CodePipeline).

• Knowledge of data security , encryption, and identity management (OAuth 2.0, SAML).

• Understanding of performance tuning, load balancing, and API monitoring .
Certifications (Preferred):

• AWS Certified Developer - Associate or Solutions Architect.

• CompTIA Security+ CE or equivalent DoD 8570 certification.

• Certified Scrum Developer (CSD) or equivalent Agile certification.
Skills:

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills for integration challenges.

• Excellent communication and teamwork in Agile environment

title: Fire and Safety Lead
description:
About Us

We are Ocado Group, and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI, and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

About the Role

Lead Ocado's global fire safety governance and assurance framework, operating directly within the corporate Health, Safety, Fire, and Environmental (HSFE) function. In this role, you will evaluate fire risk through both life safety, property protection and business continuity perspectives, providing expert guidance, oversight, and constructive challenge to product engineering and operations teams. 

As the organisation's principal fire safety competent person, you will advise and influence senior stakeholders while contributing to the broader HSFE strategic agenda. 

Key Responsibilities 

• Owning the Group's fire safety standards, methodology and assurance approach, giving competent, independent advice and challenge across every operating territory.

• Operating as a second-line function: advising business operations and engineering functions on fire risk and legal compliance, testing the effectiveness of controls and holding first-line operations to account, without owning their decisions.

• Integrating fire risk into the Group's wider HSFE risk, governance and assurance framework.

• Providing specialist technical review of entry into new territories, and ensuring fire safety considerations are embedded into contract negotiations, design, project delivery, engineering and change from concept onwards.

• Advising the business on emerging thermal risks that come with robotic automation and scale, including lithium-ion battery systems, thermal events and high-bay environments.

• Leading the Group's external fire safety relationships with regulators, fire and rescue authorities, and 3rd party auditors

• Contributing breadth across the wider HSFE Governance function: shared governance frameworks, accountability models, competence and role definitions, committee structures and assurance approaches beyond fire alone.

About you

• Degree-level qualification in a relevant discipline (e.g. risk management, fire safety,or built-environment discipline), or an equivalent recognised professional qualification supported by demonstrable industry experience.

• Current professional membership, at a grade evidencing professional competence, of a recognised fire safety, risk management or related institution (e.g. Institute of Fire Safety Managers, Institution of Fire Engineers, Institute of Risk Management, or an equivalent body in a relevant operating territory).

• Experience of fire risk management in a relevant industrial setting, including at Group, multi-site and multi-jurisdictional level, with demonstrable strategic and commercial judgement in managing risk organisationally.
